subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice target-selection work land Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX decision?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the remaining work changes user-visible companion-app session state and the issue text spans multiple native apps, so automation should not choose the permanent UX/platform scope.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Implement Android Voice/Talk selection first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before expanding to other companion apps.

options.title: Shared native Talk UX
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose one common Talk/Voice selector model across Android, iOS, and macOS.

options.title: Defer behind Chat selector
options.body: Wait until the Android Chat selector PR is repaired or closed, then reuse any accepted session-state model for Voice/Talk.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Implement Android Voice/Talk selection first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before expanding to other companion apps.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already scoped the implemented TTS half versus remaining Talk/Voice selection work in the issue discussion and has nearby TTS/config history.
